name: siela-bot
description: Self-hosted single-guild Discord bot with music, economy, Tambola, TTS, and social features.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/bot build && bun run --cwd apps/watchtower build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/config typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/db typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/watchtower typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/bot typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/shared test && bun run --cwd apps/bot test && bun run --cwd apps/watchtower test
